note: Expectations for schemas/output-descriptor/v1.schema.json. Unlike the manifest corpus there is no semantic-only group yet: nothing writes or reads a rendition until spine #5/#6/#8, so containment and key-encoding checks belong to whichever of those ships a writer. The names-needing-url-encoding fixture exists to pin that the descriptor carries such names literally, with encoding done at the S3 or URL boundary and not in this document. url_encoding_expected_paths states the names separately from the fixture so that the round-trip check compares the parsed file against something other than itself; comparing a document to its own re-serialisation can never fail.
